annotations.title: Aviation Business Travel Carbon & Radiative Forcing Calculator

description:
[Aviation business travel carbon & radiative forcing calculator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits Scope 3 Category 6 business flights with ICAO/DEFRA distance tiers and seating class allocations, including high-altitude non-CO2 radiative forcing multipliers.
Usage: Use this tool to compute corporate air travel emissions for sustainability accounting and travel policy audits.
Returns: JSON object with { flightDistanceKm: number, distanceBand: string, cabinClass: string, passengersCount: number, emissionFactorsGco2ePerPassengerKm: object, calculatedTotals: object }.

flightDistanceKm.description: Total one-way or round-trip flight distance in kilometres

includeRadiativeForcingRf.description: Whether to include the ~1.9x radiative forcing multiplier for aviation non-CO2 climate impacts (default: true)

numberOfFlights.description: Number of flight legs or return trips (default: 1)
